A coordinated visual system for an immersive, scroll-driven brand site. Fifteen standalone assets — cinematic hero plates, a four-SKU packaging range, macro spice photography and abstract texture fields — built on one lighting logic, one colour grade and one typographic hierarchy.

Colour System

Sampled from the campaign photography. Every asset grades into this palette and nothing outside it.

Deep Burgundy#7C1A21Shadow base, footer, dark acts
Vermilion#C1121FPrimary brand red, links, active states
Scarlet#E0352BChilli accent, hero glow
Burnt Orange#B85C1EWarm midtone, gradient bridge
Saffron#E9A11BGold highlight, CTA fill
Warm Ivory#F5EBDCType on dark, paper surfaces
Coriander Green#5E6B3FEarthy secondary, coriander chapter
Antique Gold#C8A24AHairlines, foil rules — restrained only
Ink#1C1013Body copy, deepest shadow
